description: This file defines the interface for media frame writing, including factory creation and the IMediaFrameWriter interface with methods for writing media segments and retrieving frame count.

classes.name: IMediaFrameWriterFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating IMediaFrameWriter instances.

classes.name: IMediaFrameWriter
classes.description: Interface for writing media frames to shared memory.

methods.name: createFrameWriter
methods.description: Creates a new IMediaFrameWriter instance with provided shared memory buffer and info.

methods.name: writeFrame
methods.description: Writes a media segment to shared memory.

methods.name: getNumFrames
methods.description: Returns the number of frames written.
